explanation: Labor-power is the unique commodity capable of creating greater economic value than it costs to maintain.

targetText: Immediate Production of Capital Capital is withdrawn from circulation and commodities put back into circulation.
explanation: Circulation time represents the period during which capital is converted between commodity form and money form.

targetText: Finance Capitalism Finance capitalists lend money at interest, without relinquishing ownership of the capital loaned', WIDTH, 250, ABOVE, true, OFFSETX, 1, BGCOLOR, '#F5FFC5', FONTSIZE, '9pt', FONTFACE, 'sans-serif', BORDERCOLOR, '#000030', SHADOW, true, SHADOWWIDTH, 3)" onMouseOut="UnTip()">
explanation: Money acts as the universal equivalent, facilitating commodity exchange while enabling capital hoarding and financial credit.

targetText: Bourgeois Society Independent producers exchange Commodities at value.
explanation: Exchange value represents the socially necessary labor-time embedded within a commodity.
